name: Narcisse
source:
I did it! At last, I'm leaving ... But Narcisse ... What about her?  What will I say to her? What will she say?

[From [url=https://a-villarroel.itch.io/narcisse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我做到了！最后，我要离开了……但是纳西斯……她呢？我要对她说什么？她会说什么？

[来自[url=https://a-villarroel.itch.io/narcisse]itch.io[/url]]
